sections.domain: Sharing the road with riders, pedestrians and large vehicles
sections.heading: Sharing the road with riders, pedestrians and large vehicles
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Sharing the road with riders, pedestrians and large vehicles

FACT_ID: sec14-R01 | anchor: A78
Pass snow-removal equipment only when the road ahead is clearly visible, using extreme caution. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec14-R02 | anchor: A78
Plowed snow can leave dangerous ridges or cause removal equipment to skid; flying material can damage following vehicles. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec14-R03 | anchor: A78
Keep a safe following gap and the printed one-hundred-foot distance behind working snow-removal or maintenance vehicles except while passing. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec14-R04 | anchor: A78
When a school bus prepares to load or unload children, its driver activates amber warning lamps. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec14-R05 | anchor: A78
When meeting or overtaking a bus with amber pre-stop warnings, slow to twenty-five miles per hour and prepare to stop. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec14-R06 | anchor: A78
A school bus's amber warnings continue until its door opens; opening the door activates the red lamps and stop arm. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec14-R07 | anchor: A78
Stop a reasonable distance from an active school-bus red-light/stop-arm warning and remain until the arm retracts and the red lamps turn off. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec14-R08 | anchor: A78
The bus-stop exception applies to a driver approaching from the opposite direction on a road divided by a median. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec14-R09 | anchor: A78
Approaching or overtaking an active red-light/extended-arm school-bus warning otherwise requires a stop. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec14-R10 | anchor: A79
The handbook's example gives a loaded truck with good tires and properly adjusted brakes at fifty-five miles per hour on a clear dry road a minimum stopping distance of three hundred forty feet. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec14-R11 | anchor: A79
Do not enter abruptly in front of a large vehicle or change lanes in front of one before turning off the road. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec14-R12 | anchor: A79
The handbook advises avoiding the right lane near steep grades or truck weigh stations where slow trucks may enter faster traffic. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec14-R13 | anchor: A79
Keep away from hazardous-material vehicles, identified by markings such as explosives, poison or flammable cargo. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec14-R14 | anchor: A79
Avoid sudden stops in front of a large truck or bus; its braking response may not be immediate. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec14-R15 | anchor: A79
An added right lane with a Slow Traffic Keep Right sign allows slower vehicles to climb a grade while other traffic passes. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec14-R16 | anchor: A79
A large vehicle may use a roundabout's raised truck apron for its rear wheels. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec14-R17 | anchor: A79
A No-Zone can be a truck or bus blind area or a location so close that it restricts the large vehicle's stopping or maneuvering space. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec14-R18 | anchor: A79
Do not pass closely behind a truck or bus that is backing or preparing to back. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec14-R19 | anchor: A80
After passing a truck or bus, do not cut back in until its entire front can be seen in the rearview mirror. [A80]
Source: [A80 -> pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R20 | anchor: A80
Do not tailgate in a truck's deep rear blind area; position where its rearview mirrors are visible. [A80]
Source: [A80 -> pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R21 | anchor: A80
Avoid travelling alongside a truck or bus for a long time because of its large side blind areas. [A80]
Source: [A80 -> pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec14-R22 | anchor: A80
Allow a wide-turning truck or bus ample room and never squeeze around it while it cannot see vehicles behind or beside it. [A80]
Source: [A80 -> pdf-0080]
